description: This file defines a router with multiple async commands related to ETF data, including search, historical data, info, sectors, countries, price performance, holdings, SEC disclosures, and equity exposure. It utilizes external modules for querying and structured command definitions.

methods.name: OBBject search( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Search for ETFs, returning full list if query is empty.

methods.name: OBBject historical( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieve ETF historical market price data.

methods.name: OBBject info( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get overview information for an ETF.

methods.name: OBBject sectors( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get sector weightings for an ETF.

methods.name: OBBject countries( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get country weightings for an ETF.

methods.name: OBBject price_performance( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get price performance data over different periods.

methods.name: OBBject holdings( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
OBBject nport_disclosure( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get SEC NPORT-P disclosure filings for ETFs or mutual funds.

methods.name: OBBject equity_exposure( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get ETF exposure for a specific stock.
